# Format, one per line:   rule-id:path:line
# `#` starts a comment. Always leave one saying why — an entry with no reasoning is
# indistinguishable from someone silencing an inconvenient check.

# Adding a line here is a decision that a specific value is safe in public. It is not a way
# to make the build green. If you have not read the line the finding points at, do not add it.
